name: aurevoy
description: Aurevoy — 让每个人都拥有属于自己的 AI Agent。通用个人 AI Agent 桌面产品。

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run prepare-agent-dev && concurrently -n shared,desktop -c magenta,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:agent: npm run prepare-agent-dev && npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @aurevoy/agent
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web-ui && npm run build -w @aurevoy/agent && npm run prepare-agent-deps && npm run build -w @aurevoy/desktop
scripts.prepare-desktop-bundle: npm run prepare-agent-deps && npm run prepare-node-runtime
scripts.regression:long-loop: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web-ui && npm run build -w @aurevoy/agent && vitest run packages/web-ui/src/components/conversationWorkflow.test.ts packages/web-ui/src/components/Timeline.test.tsx && tsx scripts/long-loop-regression.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web-ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
